name: agent-custom-setup
audience_feeling: The reader should feel that messy Desktop launchers can become a versioned registry without putting secrets into git.
promise: Register sanitized agent setups with explicit versions and temporal metadata.

preferred_terms.custom setup: a launcher and notes package for one agent tool
preferred_terms.registry: the index of modules with temporal metadata

good_examples: Your Claude Code InferHub launcher lives on Desktop. This registry keeps a sanitized, versioned copy.
Secrets stay in Desktop configs/.env and InferHub .env — never in this repository.
bad_examples: A seamless AI-powered launcher platform that securely stores all your keys.
One repo to rule every agent setup forever.
